subject: Supplier invite: first click lands blank — cookie reconciliation and manual-activation options
messages:
From: Thomas Reid <thomas.reid@bloxers.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: procure-ops@bloxers.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier portal invite not completing first click

Hi Ben —

We received the supplier invite this morning but the very first click on the acceptance link loads a white page and never redirects back to our portal. The Accept button shows briefly, then the page stays blank. This is blocking our supplier setup and PO issuance — we have a PO on hold for vendor "Green Pines Logistics".

What we tried so far:
- Chrome (Mac) latest — same behavior
- Incognito — same thing
- Cleared cookies and retried — same
- Mobile (iOS Safari) accepted once but then the vendor record is not visible in our portal; unsure if that actually completed the onboarding.

Attached a screenshot of the blank page and a short screen recording (screenshot-blankpage.png). Please advise — we need this vendor activated today to avoid delayed shipments.

Thanks,
Thomas Reid
Procurement Ops — Bloxers Inc.
procure-ops@bloxers.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Reid <thomas.reid@bloxers.com>, procure-ops@bloxers.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite not completing first click

Hi Thomas — thanks for the report and sorry for the friction here.

I can confirm we saw an error spike from your tenant around 09:05 PT and are looking into root cause. Quick questions to help triage:
- Which browser + exact version did you test (you mentioned Chrome Mac)?
- Do you have a tenant id or the invite token from the email (if you can paste the last 8 chars that helps us find the session)
- Any corporate proxy or web filtering that might rewrite cookies or set SameSite policies?

Workarounds we can try right away:
1) I can resend an alternate accept link that forces a server-side handoff (avoids the client-side redirect).
2) If you'd prefer, we can manually activate the vendor record on our side so you can process the PO immediately — Marcus (onsite onboarding) is copied to confirm manual activation SLA.

Laura, Marcus — can you pick this up? Marcus, if we can't get a clean accept, can we activate vendor manually and send confirmation so Bloxers can proceed?

Thomas — attaching a short session log request template if you can grab browser console/network HAR (session-logs-20270927.txt). If you send that we can correlate with server logs.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Thomas Reid <thomas.reid@bloxers.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite not completing first click

Hi team — I dug into the request traces for Bloxers (tenant: BLOX-99321) and saw a short-lived 302 then a 200 with an empty response body for the accept endpoint. Two likely culprits: SameSite cookie partitioning combined with a corporate proxy that strips/refactors third-party cookies; or a client-side script error preventing the final redirect.

Immediate steps for Thomas/procure-ops to help us debug:
- Try the alternate accept URL (server-handshake) I generated: https://supplier.redwood.app/accept?token=*****REDACTED*****&force_accept=true — open in incognito and in a non-corporate network (phone hotspot) if possible.
- Capture a HAR (Chrome DevTools > Network > Save as HAR) or a full network capture and attach to an email. Filename: BLOX-HAR-<timestamp>.har
- If you see a Content-Security-Policy or proxy-related header in the response we asked for, include the top 20 response headers.

If the accept URL above still returns a blank body, we can do a manual activation: I can create the vendor record for Green Pines Logistics (company data from your PO) and mark it active so your AP team can issue the PO. Manual activation note: this bypasses the external vendor's self-onboarding flow so we will need an explicit indemnity checkbox completed by Bloxers procurement (I attached short instructions).

Timeline: If you can send the HAR or confirm willingness for manual activation I can complete manual activation within 2 hours.

Attachments: manual-activation-instructions.pdf (activation steps + indemnity checkbox)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Onboarding Manager, Partner Success | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Reid <thomas.reid@bloxers.com>, procure-ops@bloxers.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite not completing first click

Thomas — quick update: Marcus completed a manual activation for Green Pines Logistics at 14:00 PT after you confirmed acceptance of the temporary indemnity note. I attached a short activation confirmation and the internal activation id (ACT-9921).

What we did for you:
- Created vendor record: Green Pines Logistics (Vendor ID: VX-7782)
- Marked onboarding complete and pushed initial supplier metadata to Bloxers tenant
- Confirmed AP can now create/route PO — please try creating the PO and let me know if it flows through or if any visibility is missing on your side.

Attachments: activation-confirmation-20270927.txt

If you prefer we can continue to dig into the original blank-page root cause (Marcus has asked for the HAR); it's safe to leave things using the manual activation but we'd like to resolve the redirect for future vendors.

Thanks for the patience — apologies again for the disruption.

Ben
